title: Longest Balanced Substring I
summary: Given a string of lowercase English letters, find the length of the longest substring where each distinct character appears the same number of times.
statement: Given a string of lowercase English letters, find the length of the longest substring where each distinct character appears the same number of times.
constraints: s contains one to 1,000 lowercase English letters.
A substring is balanced when all characters present in it have equal frequency.
Return the maximum balanced substring length.
hints: If every present character has one common frequency f, then window length equals f times its distinct-character count.
For each left endpoint, extend right while maintaining frequencies, their maximum, and the distinct count.
A window is balanced exactly when maximum×distinct equals its length.
All counts are positive and at most the maximum, so equality of their sum with maximum×count forces every count to equal the maximum.
editorial: All counts are positive and at most the maximum, so equality of their sum with maximum×count forces every count to equal the maximum.

The substring zabc contains four distinct letters once each.
